title: Add A2A lease-age filters for stale work
summary: Make stale in-flight A2A work easier to find by adding minimum lease-age filters to queue/status surfaces without introducing automatic retry.
expectedFailureModes: Operators cannot reliably identify stale in-flight leases before using repair commands.
A filter hides queued tasks or pending results in a way that makes queue state look healthier than it is.
Lease-age calculation uses wall-clock subtraction unsafely and underflows on bad timestamps.
The CLI presents stale work as safe to retry automatically instead of requiring explicit duplicate-risk posture.
verification: cd agent-os && cargo test -p covenantd a2a_queue --locked
cd agent-os && cargo test -p covenant a2a --locked
humanEscalation: Approval before enabling automatic retry or time-based repair execution
nextAction: Integrated; next A2A hardening slice should add live CLI repair coverage for stale in-flight inspection, requeue, and force-error flows.
